title: BP Energy Outlook 2035
scenario_note: bp describes a single 'most likely' view.

entries.subject: oil
entries.metric: global liquids demand (oil, biofuels and other liquids)
entries.quote: Global liquids demand (oil, biofuels, and other liquids) nonetheless is likely to rise by around 19 Mb/d, to reach 109 Mb/d by 2035.

entries.subject: renewables
entries.metric: renewables share of primary energy (renewables incl. biofuels, excl. hydro)
entries.quote: Among non-fossil fuels, renewables (including biofuels) gain share rapidly, from around 2% today to 7% by 2035, while hydro and nuclear remain fairly flat.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: plug-in vehicle share of new vehicle sales
entries.quote: Plug-in vehicles, including full battery electric vehicles (BEVs), are forecast to make up 7% of sales in 2035.
entries.note: Sales share, not a fleet count.

notes: Summary tables exist (.xls on archive.org) but the old binary .xls format was not parsed (no xls reader available without adding a dependency). Figures from report text. No EV count.
